explanation: Ali Baba first appeared in print in Antoine Galland's French translation of the Arabian Nights, in the early 1700s; no older Arabic text of the tale is known.

claims.text: In the tale of Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves, the words 'Open sesame' open the robbers' cave.
The magic words in the tale are not abracadabra, hocus pocus or alakazam.
The tale of Ali Baba first appeared in print in Antoine Galland's French translation of the Arabian Nights, in the early 18th century.
No Arabic text of the Ali Baba tale older than Galland's version is known.
